scope: Dependency and dataset input materials only; the final candidate and its qualification are separate.
changes: Cargo.lock differs from the 0.1.6 file (sha256 076009bb18f2902ee4746edeebf5701a5b507c3f9da0c1f6b914745cf22ef89f) by two lines, both inside the entry of the noh package itself: its version, 0.1.6 to 0.2.0, and one more dependency, sha2 0.11.1. No third-party package is added, removed or changed.

sha2 0.11.1 was already a package of the 0.1.6 lock, required by rmcp; its record is unchanged. NOH now requires it directly as well, under the gui feature, to name the preview copies by the SHA-256 of a file's content.

Nothing else in the 0.2.0 source changes adds a dependency: the montage is played through the libmpv library the host provides, as assets/linux-host.json (unchanged) already states, loaded with libloading; the start-up log uses rfd, chrono and eframe's glow. All were locked.

assets/syllable-sources.lock.json differs from the 0.1.6 file (sha256 0fbdc49bec0cf13f206f9363aa98174201f2c658fcbaafb85f3394a37f318f5d) in its two dataset entries; the pins of the built dictionaries (outputs: words and sha256 for en and fr) are unchanged.

Moby entry: three mirror addresses of the same archive are added (mirrors, mirrors_checked), tried in order when the first address does not answer. Its sha256, member and member_sha256 are unchanged: the pinned SHA-256 accepts the same bytes from any address.

Lexique entry: its publisher repacked the archive on 2026-11-17 (Last-Modified of the served file). The archive's sha256 moves from e181d132b3b0d3d87efc98d376968441b517353933011cebea5366321a6024e6 to 8555c3b726ae74f83a1866f3690843f2b7e609b6270189cc5b1d5bac96c7d3ac and the member's path from Lexique383.tsv to Lexique383/Lexique383.tsv; member_sha256 is unchanged.
Every other hashed input is byte-identical to its 0.1.6 value.

licence_reading.method: Rust records: none read, no third-party record changed, so the 0.1.6 reading stands as recorded in the prior review, with its stated limits. Datasets: the repacked Lexique archive was compared file by file with the reviewed one; see dataset_licences.
